negative_controls: Reject MediaStore publish failures with IOException
Failed or unpublished files trigger ContentResolver.delete
No screenshot/log URI returned before IS_PENDING=0 succeeds
budget: source-only Android compile and small Python/JVM checks; no APK or Unity
observed_result: Source fix commit cf764d7, regression controls commit a71ef5f; CI in progress / pending when recorded.
limitations: Not yet tested on Android15 MediaStore provider
Overwriting existing exported logs via ContentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, wt) remains non-transactional; this change protects newly inserted media only.
No game APK/OBB identity or gameplay acceptance proof.
